name: Aegis the Unbroken
skill: On Summon by any method: you may banish 5 cards from your hand to return all Units in your Discard pile to your deck. All or nothing.
art_note: Minotaur boss; plaid/gold/white armour, tower shield, battle mace.

name: Ironhide Sentinel
skill: While this Unit is on the field, your Tower cannot be attacked.
art_note: Armoured grizzly bear.

name: Alexia, the Silver Sword
skill: Multistrike - if this Unit wins a combat roll it may attack a second time this Battle Phase. Optional. Maximum 2 attacks per phase.
art_note: Elf; full plate, dark brown ponytail with bangs, green eyes, pale Norse complexion, thin fast two-handed blade.

name: Alfred the Noble Knight
skill: Adjacent Tier 1 and Tier 2 Units you control add +3 to their rolls. Does not buff this Unit.
art_note: Cavalry on a lean painted mare, bright white gold-trim plate, diamond cavalry shield, short silver sword raised.

name: Garrek, the Steel Wind
skill: When this Unit rolls in combat, an even result destroys the enemy Unit outright regardless of its roll.
art_note: Dual-wielding steel longswords; brown trench coat over leather, light armour over gold-white plate; grizzled mercenary.

name: Steadfast Warden
skill: Once per turn: return 1 Honor Dweller Unit from your Discard pile to your deck.
art_note: Templar in cloth robes, silver kite shield, flanged mace with gold hilt and blue gem.

name: Elven Outrider
skill: When this Unit destroys an enemy Unit in combat and its roll was even, your opponent discards 1 random card from their hand.
art_note: Mounted on a reindeer/caribou; silver hair, green hood, leather cloak; scout-tracker.

name: Valen, the Bear Brawler
skill: Units adjacent to this Unit cannot be selected as an attack target.
art_note: Male elf; twin wooden axes carved from his home forest; bear companion in art only.

name: Vale Huntress
art_note: Bow plus big-cat companion (jaguar or tiger).

name: Elvish Sniper
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On an odd result, destroy 1 face-up enemy Unit regardless of its roll.
art_note: Golden hair with silver sheen, white cloak with gold or red highlights, crouched fully-drawn stance.

name: Wooden Catapult
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On 1 to 4, your opponent chooses 1 Unit they control and sends it to the Discard pile.
art_note: Basic wooden siege weapon.

name: Standard Bearer
skill: Adjacent Honor Dwellers you control add +2 to their rolls.
art_note: Unarmoured, ragged military coat, large white flag with golden cross emblem.

name: Honored Drummer
skill: Adjacent Units that are not Honor Dwellers subtract 1 from their rolls.
art_note: Unarmoured drummer.

name: Forest Tiger
art_note: Vanilla stat-stick, tribute/evolution fodder.

name: Great Brown Bear
art_note: Vanilla stat-stick, tribute/evolution fodder.

name: Bog-Dwelling Stalker
art_note: Black jaguar/panther, tribute/evolution fodder.

name: Elvish Beast Caller
skill: On Summon by any method: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 or Tier 2 Forest Dweller and add it to your hand, then shuffle.
art_note: Elf with a whip.

name: Monastery Protector
skill: When this Unit destroys an enemy Unit in combat: return 1 card of your choice from your Discard pile to your deck.
art_note: Friar bodyguard: brown robes, white and gold trim, tonsure, giant two-handed white mace.

name: Monastery Scholar
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: add 1 card from your Discard pile to your deck, then shuffle.
art_note: Black clerical robes, glasses, seated reading a black tome with the Honor sigil on its spine.

name: Silverlight Dancer
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: return 1 banished Unit to your hand.
art_note: Ethereal night-fairy: iridescent silhouette, big yellow eyes, green lunar moth wings with white accents, silver hair.

name: Wolf Pup
art_note: Cute wolf pup - the first wolf in the game.

name: Makeshift Catapult
skill: Once per turn: if your opponent draws a card outside their Draw Phase, they must immediately discard that card.
art_note: Basic improvised siege weapon.

name: Makeshift Wall
skill: If a Unit you control adjacent to this Unit would be destroyed, destroy this Unit instead.
art_note: Improvised wall/barricade.

name: Makeshift Ballista
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. Even - mill the top card of your opponent's deck. Odd - destroy this Unit.
art_note: Improvised siege weapon.

name: Orion's Blessing
skill: Discard this card from your hand: force a reroll of any one dice roll.
art_note: Herald descending from the god Orion; gold-trimmed robes with red feather accents, ceremonial spear, robes billowing upward mid-descent.

name: Makeshift Tower
art_note: Banged-together improvised archer tower.

name: Honored Spearman
art_note: Chainmail and white sigil cloak, Solaire-style bucket great helm, forward stance with spear thrust out.

name: City Guard
art_note: Cropped Skyrim-style guard helm (jaw visible), torch, chainmail under white sigil cloak, at a city gate.

name: Honor Archer
art_note: Lighter scout variant of the City Guard look.

name: Forest Squirrel
art_note: Side profile, munching a nut, red or grey squirrel.

name: Forest Caiman
art_note: Swamp predator; forest counterpart to Bog-Dwelling Stalker.

name: Forest Rabbit
art_note: White fur, red eyes, caught mid-scratch with a back foot.

name: Foraging Foxes
skill: On Summon: draw 1 card.
art_note: Two red foxes in underbrush, one nose-down foraging, one nose-up on watch.

name: Bear Cave
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: discard the top card of your deck to Special Summon 1 Bear Token to the square in front of this Unit.
art_note: Simple cave-mouth structure.

name: Forest Maple
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: shuffle 1 card from your hand into your deck to Special Summon 1 Squirrel Token.
art_note: Simple tree, squirrel peeking from a knot in the trunk.

name: Charging Buck
skill: While this Unit is ridden by an Honor Dweller, it adds +2 to its roll.
art_note: Buck leaping a fallen log, front legs tucked, back legs extended.

name: Doe
skill: Once per turn: shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck, then draw 2 cards.
art_note: Timid watchful doe, matching Charging Buck's family.

name: Shepherd
skill: When this Unit is destroyed in battle: search your Discard pile for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Forest Dweller and add it to your hand.
art_note: Male elf in a wolfskin or deer-hide cloak tending a free-range herd; weathered, practical.

name: City Guard Dog
skill: 1 adjacent Unit you control adds +1 to its roll.
art_note: Slightly goofy Great Dane in city-guard-adjacent gear.

name: Town Crier
skill: On Summon: if you have no cards in your hand, draw 5 cards.
art_note: On a soapbox, scroll held out, drab robes, chubby, red-faced with passionate energy.

name: Bear Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed. Destroyed permanently when it leaves the field.

name: Squirrel Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed. Destroyed permanently when it leaves the field.

name: Rummaging Rodent
skill: On Normal Summon: draw 1 card.

name: Crypt Bat
skill: Swap places with any Unit you control on the board.
art_note: Cave-dwelling dungeon bat. Flying is flavour only, no mechanic.

name: Flaming Jack Rabbit
skill: If this card would be discarded or destroyed, shuffle it into your deck instead of sending it to the Discard pile.
art_note: Small fast lava-critter jackrabbit.

name: Cinder Bat
skill: On Death: adjacent Lava Dwellers add +1 to their next roll this turn; adjacent non-Lava Dwellers subtract 1 from their next roll this turn.
art_note: Charred remains: cracked ashen skin, embers through the gaps, blocky and elemental. Grounded, not floating.

name: Disembodied Hand
skill: Roll this Unit's die. On a 1, 3 or 5, look at the top card of your opponent's deck and return it to the top.

name: Skeleton
art_note: Bare-bones skeleton, unarmed, no weapon. Deliberately the weakest undead grunt.

name: Graveyard Wraith
skill: Dungeon Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls.

name: Ash Skink
skill: On Normal Summon: draw 1 card.
art_note: Charred remains aesthetic, same language as Cinder Bat. Classic FF earth/fire elemental blockiness.

name: Undead Hound
skill: When destroyed: search your deck for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Ember Wisp
skill: When destroyed: search your deck for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.
art_note: Small floating ember spirit. Ties to Molten Field's tokens and Ash Golem's payoff.

name: Grave Snare
skill: When this Unit is attacked while face down: after the battle resolves, the attacking Unit subtracts 2 from its next roll this turn.

name: Immolation Trap
skill: When this Unit is attacked while face down: after the battle resolves, destroy both this Unit and the attacking Unit.

name: Grave Shifter
skill: Swap places with any Unit on the board, yours or your opponent's.

name: Immovable Bog
skill: Dungeon and Forest Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls. All other Dweller Types in those squares subtract 3.
art_note: A swamp/bog - terrain, not a creature. Borders dungeon and forest biomes.

name: Molten Field
skill: Lava Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls. At the start of your Recruitment Phase, Special Summon 1 Wisp Token to your Barracks.
art_note: Field of molten terrain. Lava counterpart to Immovable Bog.

name: Cinder Skeleton
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: you may attach this card from your hand to an adjacent Lava Dweller you control as a Ride. This does not use your Normal Summon.

name: Bone Diviner
skill: Discard this card from your hand, then roll a d6. On 1 to 4, every Unit your opponent controls of the corresponding Tier subtracts 2 from its rolls until the end of their next turn. On 5 or 6, nothing happens.
art_note: Name suggests a bone-reading scryer. Never discussed on record.

name: Magma Mine
skill: Discard this card from your hand, then roll a d6. On 1 to 4, destroy 1 Unit your opponent controls of the corresponding Tier. On 5 or 6, nothing happens.
art_note: A spiked naval mine, but molten, drifting in a sea of lava instead of water.

name: Skeletal Mage
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On a 7 or 8, mill the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Shallow Grave
skill: Mandatory. Every Recruitment Phase: Special Summon 1 Zombie Token to your Barracks. This is not optional.
art_note: A cracked headstone with a hand already clawing up through the dirt beside it.

name: Undead Mare
skill: If a Tier 1 Unit Rides this card, the stack adds +2 to its roll in battle.
art_note: Undead horse. The mount Ashen Lancer rides.

name: Ghoul Rider
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand.

name: Slagborn
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand.

name: Goblin Bomb Carrier
skill: When this Unit is destroyed by an opponent's card: add 1 Magma Mine from your deck to your hand.
art_note: Small goblin carrying a mine far too heavy for him. Comic-relief fodder.

name: Flesh Collector
skill: Cleave - when this Unit wins a combat roll, also destroy 1 enemy Unit orthogonally adjacent to the Unit it defeated.
art_note: Lean hunched emaciated zombie golem stitched from corpses, tattered leather, dragging a big battle axe. Necromancer-conscript, not the bulky zombie trope.

name: Gargoyle
art_note: Stone dungeon muscle. Perched with Dungeon Door guarding the boss-room approach.

name: Dungeon Door
skill: This Unit and adjacent Units you control add +1 to their rolls, regardless of Dweller Type.
art_note: Ornate dungeon door/archway, part of the back-of-dungeon wall lineup.

name: Charnel Warden
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: banish 1 card from your Discard pile to Special Summon 1 Zombie Token.
art_note: Necromancer figure - an enchanted summon built to protect an area.

name: Ashen Lancer
skill: When this Unit moves during the Battle Phase, every Unit you control adjacent to it moves the same number of squares in the same direction. This does not use those Units' own movement.
art_note: Mounted on an Undead Mare, double-headed lance with blue flame, tattered dark purple and black armour.

name: Ash Golem
skill: This Unit adds +1 to its roll for each Wisp Token adjacent to it.

name: Ashlands
skill: Dungeon and Lava Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +2 to their rolls. No penalty to anything else.
art_note: Scorched ashen wasteland terrain, not a creature.

name: Lavagoyle
art_note: Ferro-imp brute, no wings, white cracked molten-rock skin with lava glowing beneath the cracks. Lava counterpart to Gargoyle.

name: Lich King
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: Special Summon 1 Tier 1 Dungeon Dweller from your Discard pile to an empty Barracks square.
art_note: Skyrim's Dragon Lich crossed with the Overlord anime lead.

name: Death Knight
art_note: Armoured undead knight. Boss-room guard for the Lich King.

name: Corrupted Paladin
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On an even result, destroy 1 Unit your opponent controls. On an odd result, banish 1 Unit from your opponent's Discard pile.
art_note: Working title Dark Knight. NOT undead - a human paladin corrupted by dark arts. Wings/ornament on shoulder pauldrons, not the helm, to keep a grounded melee silhouette.

name: Zombie Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Wisp Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Skeleton Knight Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Charnel Reaper
skill: Banish 2 cards from your Discard pile: Special Summon 2 Tokens adjacent to this Unit.

name: Bone Harvester
skill: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand: Special Summon that many Tokens.

name: Charnel Sovereign
skill: Special Summon up to 4 Skeleton Knight Tokens. Pay the cost in any combination of banishing Dungeon Dwellers from your Discard pile, discarding from your hand, or milling from your deck.

name: Grave Tracker
skill: On Normal Summon: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 3 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Cinder Stalker
skill: On Normal Summon: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 3 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Sepulcher Hunter
skill: While this card is in your Discard pile you may banish it: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 4 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Magma Seeker
skill: While this card is in your Discard pile you may banish it: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 4 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Ossuary Warden
skill: Discard this card from your hand: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 4 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Pyre Warden
skill: Discard this card from your hand: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 4 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Bonecarver
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand or deck.

name: Emberwright
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand or deck.

name: Tower of Bones
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your Discard pile or deck.

name: Pyre
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your Discard pile or deck.

name: Crypt Caller
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon 1 Dungeon Dweller from your Discard pile to that stack's square. No Tier restriction.
art_note: Death Knight riding an Undead Drake. Tattered undead wyvern, all bark and decrepit menace with genuine bite. Reuses the Death Knight and Drake models rather than a new capstone sculpt.

name: Magma Minefield
skill: Once per turn: add 1 Magma Mine from your deck or Discard pile to your hand.

name: Undead Drake
skill: Once per turn: if this Unit is part of a Ride stack, send this card to the Discard pile instead of destroying the stack.
art_note: Flying Drake, explicitly NOT a true dragon. Tattered wings, looks weak and decrepit but is stronger than it looks. Same asset as Crypt Caller's mount.

name: Undead Cavalry
skill: Discard 2 cards: Special Summon this Unit from your hand or your Discard pile.
art_note: Death Knight riding the Undead Mare. A combination card reusing two existing models, not a new sculpt.
